items.item_text: Board certified or board eligible by the American Board of Thoracic Surgery (ABTS), with specialization in congenital heart surgery.
Possess or be eligible for California medical licensure.

Take on a vital role within a world-class academic health system and help deliver life-saving surgical care to patients of all ages. In partnership with UCLA Health and Children’s Hospital of Orange County (CHOC), we are seeking a Congenital Heart Surgeon to join our esteemed Department of Surgery, recognized nationally for clinical excellence, innovation, and compassionate care. This is a contract-based opportunity to perform complex congenital cardiac surgeries across both institutions.
Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams including pediatric cardiologists, intensivists, perfusionists, and specialty-trained nursing staff.
Practice among two leading institutions - UCLA Health in Los Angeles and Children’s Hospital of Orange County - with access to state-of-the-art surgical suites and ICU resources.
Contribute to a high-volume program that emphasizes quality outcomes, continuous innovation, and compassionate care.
Participate in ongoing clinical and academic collaborations in an environment that supports excellence in patient care, teaching, and research.
Willingness to travel between UCLA Health and CHOC campuses.
Strong commitment to advancing care for patients with congenital heart disease across all ages.

The Congenital Heart Surgery Program at UCLA Health and CHOC is a nationally recognized leader in complex heart care, offering advanced treatment for a full spectrum of congenital heart conditions. With an emphasis on multidisciplinary care, innovation, and family-centered approaches, our program has earned a reputation for outstanding outcomes and compassionate service. Learn more about our partnership

Whether you’re based near West Los Angeles, home to the UCLA campus, or in Orange County, where CHOC is located, Southern California offers an exceptional lifestyle. Enjoy sunny weather year-round, world-famous beaches, scenic mountains, vibrant cultural life, and top-tier public and private schools. With easy access to both urban centers and coastal escapes, this region is ideal for work-life balance and professional growth.
